sloka: एते नागाः काद्रवेया स्तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रा विषोल्बणाः ।रक्षोमायाप्रभावेन शरा भूत्वा त्वदाश्रिताः ।। ६.५०.४९ ।।।।
transliteration: ete nāgāḥ kādraveyā stīkṣṇadaṁṣṭrā viṣolbaṇāḥ ।rakṣomāyāprabhāvena śarā bhūtvā tvadāśritāḥ ।। 6.50.49 ।।।।

translations.english: "These arrows are serpents born of Kadra Devata. They have sharp fangs and are highly poisonous. By the tricks of Rakshasa, it has turned into arrows and reached you."
